description: GET /instruments/{id}/price (§4.1, §3.11 item 11, DEC-2152): the last trusted daily bar of an instrument GET /instruments lists, as mandate-bars' trust rule admits it at the API's clock: the close of the last completed regular equity session, never a bid, a quote or a current price. When no trusted bar can be served, reported is false with one reason and no close: never a stub. as_of names the control stream the instrument was read from; the envelope's served_at is the API clock the bars were read at.

symbol.description: The listed instrument's symbol, as GET /instruments serves it.

reported.description: Whether a trusted bar is served.

close.description: The bar's close as stored, the last completed regular session's.

timeframe.description: The bar's timeframe: daily alone in v1 (DEC-2152 alternatives).

source.description: alpaca-iex for the data process's generations root (staging), recorded for any other root (the local cell's recording).

reason.description: Why no trusted bar is served: no_store (no bars root, or it does not exist), not_covered (an asset class other than us_equity), no_bars (no dataset manifest where the root and clock name it), untrusted (anything mandate-bars refuses or cannot read).
